summary.en: Israel continues air and drone strikes in southern Lebanon, killing a Hezbollah operative, wounding another, and killing a civilian on a motorcycle while wounding a second. Hezbollah responded with artillery fire on Israeli positions and began distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reported 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. Israel also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, a development not mentioned in the previous briefing.
summary.nb: Israel fortsetter luft- og droneram på sørlige Libanon, og dreper en Hezbollah-operativ, sårer en annen, og dreper en sivil på motorsykkel mens en annen blir såret. Hezbollah svarte med artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og begynte å distribuere sine første kontantutbetalinger til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. FN rapporterte at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Israel bygde også en ny vei i bufferområdet Shebaa-dalen, en utvikling som ikke ble nevnt i forrige briefing.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
